summary: Comprehensive testing of KOYA Market Round 2 features. All 18 backend tests passed (1 skipped due to cart minimum). Frontend UI tests verified all new features working correctly.

zones_de_livraison_page.details: Page loads at /zones-livraison with Leaflet map, postal code checker works (75011=eligible complete, 13001=not eligible)

navigation_menu.details: 'Zones de livraison' link present in navigation menu

careers_page.details: Page at /carrieres shows 5 job listings with full details

job_detail_page.details: Clicking job at /carrieres/dev shows full fiche de poste with missions, salary (3500€-5000€), requirements, benefits

jobs_api.details: /api/jobs returns 5 jobs with full details (id, title, location, type, salary, department, description, missions, requirements, benefits)

referral_api.details: /api/referral returns referral code (KOYA-XXXXXX format) for authenticated user with points_per_referral=10

categories_api.details: /api/categories returns 11 categories including 'Épicerie Africaine' and 'Épicerie Caribéenne'

reviews_api.details: /api/reviews/prod_001 endpoint works (returns empty list if no reviews seeded)

order_tracking_api.details: /api/orders/{orderId}/tracking returns tracking data with driver_name, driver_phone, steps, estimated_arrival, driver_lat/lng

product_quantity_popover.details: Product card shows quantity popover on + click with +/- buttons and confirm add button

cart_loyalty_info.details: Cart page shows 'Code fidélité' input with placeholder 'Code FIDELITE-XXXXXXXX' and helper text. Loyalty points info banner shows when user has >=100 points

account_parrainage_tab.details: Account page has Parrainage tab showing user's referral code (KOYA-XXXXXX), referrals count, and apply referral code input

new_categories_in_catalogue.details: Catalogue sidebar shows 'Épicerie Africaine' and 'Épicerie Caribéenne' categories

context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 2 features all implemented and tested: 1) Zones de livraison page with Leaflet map at /zones-livraison, 2) Referral system with /api/referral endpoint and Parrainage tab in account, 3) Careers page with full job details at /carrieres/:jobId, 4) Reviews API at /api/reviews/{product_id}, 5) Cart shows loyalty code input, 6) New categories Épicerie Africaine and Caribéenne (11 total), 7) Product quantity selector popover on + click, 8) Order tracking API with simulated driver location. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_koya_round2.py.

mocked_apis.order_tracking_location: MOCKED - Driver location and ETA are simulated based on time elapsed
